# Verified JSON repository instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow the exact committed work packet before editing. The same rules apply when delegating to a subagent; include the repository instructions in its context.

Preserve frozen specification, theorem types, hypotheses and meaning-bearing definitions. Change only the packet's allowed files and declaration holes. Proof-only work cannot alter executable behavior, dependencies, CI or verification policy.

No `sorry`, `admit`, extra axioms, disabled kernel checks or unproved native substitutions are accepted in mathematical submissions. Proof/implementation tickets use the qualified packet validator; a generic build or grep is insufficient. Bootstrap, review and tests/docs tasks use their frozen manual checklist and applicable empirical checks; do not fabricate Lean verdicts for an unbuilt verifier. Infrastructure failure is not PASS.

Claims use native GitHub assignment and an acknowledged six-hour deadline, with manual expiry initially. No claim bot is available. Claims do not grant merge, release, credential or publication authority.
